pages.title: Item Name
pages.text: A Blueprint's display name comes from the source PreFab: $(li)Named PreFab: "Iron Smelter" → Blueprint named "Iron Smelter" $(li)Unnamed PreFab: Blueprint shows default "PreFab Blueprint" name

pages.title: Tooltip
pages.text: Hovering over a Blueprint shows: $(li)$(bold)Source$(): Original PreFab name (or room code) $(li)$(bold)Room dimensions$(): X×Y×Z size of the factory room $(li)$(bold)Resources required$(): List of blocks and items needed for printing $(li)Items with NBT requirements show a `[NBT]` marker $(li)$(bold)Production rates$(): Input rates (negative, consumed) and output rates (positive, produced) $(li)Sorted by rate, outputs first

pages.title: Right-Click Chat Display
pages.text: Right-click a Blueprint in hand to view its full contents in chat:$(br2)$(li)Source PreFab name and room dimensions $(li)Complete resource cost list (all items, unlimited — chat scrolls) $(li)Full production rate list (all rates shown) $(li)Color-coded: gold headers, green section titles, white entries$(br2)Empty/blank Blueprints show: "This blueprint is blank."$(br2)---
